create_agent_add_to_db: create an agent and add it to the database with litellm params, headers, and rate limits
delete_agent_from_db: delete an agent from the database by its agent id
patch_agent_in_db: patch an agent in the database with partial updates to name, params, or permissions
update_agent_in_db: update an agent in the database with full replacement of name, params, headers, and rate limits
get_all_agents_from_db: get all agents from the database ordered by creation time descending
